requirements: R1: Patch the backend synchronization logic to correctly align the internal task status with the actual GitHub PR state (e.g., closed without merge).

slices.title: Patch GitHub PR status synchronization logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization fix for this epic, I want to accurately parse and reflect the GitHub PR state, so that the internal task status is not falsely marked as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an associated GitHub PR,
When the PR is closed without a merge,
Then the backend synchronization logic accurately updates the task status to reflect the PR's true state without falsely marking it as done, and relevant tests verify this behavior.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce task status mismatches between internal system and GitHub from current levels to 0%
